subject: Locust Street Development Project
overview: The Medford City Council met to address community concerns regarding a newly approved 490-unit residential development on Locust Street. The Council voted to explore an appeal of the Zoning Board of Appeals decision, request funding for outside legal counsel, seek zoning review assistance, and schedule a special meeting.

items.title: Assistant City Solicitor Salary Reclassification
items.summary: The council approved the first reading of an ordinance amendment upgrading the Assistant City Solicitor position from classification CAF-10 to CAF-12.

items.title: Reappointment to the License Commission
items.summary: The council confirmed the reappointment of James Flynn to the License Commission for a term expiring June 1, 2022.

items.title: Sisters Against Ovarian Cancer Awareness Campaign
items.summary: The council approved a resolution granting Sisters Against Ovarian Cancer permission to display teal ribbons across the city in September.

items.title: Dedications and Condolences
items.summary: The council dedicated the meeting to the victims of the Orlando shooting and observed a moment of silence for deceased residents David Semenza Jr. and Robert Sarabian.

items.title: Discussion and Legal Appeal of Locust Street Development
items.summary: Councilors and residents voiced opposition to the Zoning Board of Appeals' approval of 11 variances for a 490-unit development on Locust Street, citing traffic congestion, school capacity, and environmental concerns. The council voted to solicit outside legal counsel on appealing the ZBA decision, request mayoral funding for legal fees, ask the MAPC to review city zoning, request a six-month moratorium on ZBA variances for projects over 150 units, and schedule a special Saturday meeting.

items.title: Common Victualler License for Sura Barbecue
items.summary: The council approved a Common Victualler License for Sura Barbecue Boston Incorporated to operate at 27 Riverside Avenue.

items.title: Locust Street Resolutions and Legal Opinion
items.summary: The council placed a resolution requesting the ZBA reopen its hearing on file as moot, withdrew two related papers, and approved the city solicitor's report regarding appeal procedures.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The council tabled the meeting records of May 31, 2016, and approved the records of June 7, 2016.
